facts.fact: 叙述者从前数蚊子包，曾在 Bass Lake 钓鱼赛那天在一条胳膊上数出二十八个包。
facts.anchor: I counted twenty-eight total itches on a single appendage.

facts.fact: 她现在数的却是残酷的统计：Crane Lake 医院四月有十三个、五月有十四个印第安婴儿带着毒瘾出生。
facts.anchor: thirteen Indian babies were born addicted to drugs in April; fourteen Indian babies were born addicted in May.

facts.fact: 她三十岁不到已经打过十七份工，连保姆都算——醉酒的男主人回家想给她「小费」。
facts.anchor: Seventeen. That’s counting the babysitting gigs where drunken men would come home and want to give me “a bonus.”

facts.fact: 那年秋天她被部落解雇后，十岁的 Aanakwad Blackduck 像魔术一样从一堆金色落叶里蹦出来。
facts.anchor: Then Aanakwad popped out of a pile of leaf gold.

facts.fact: Aanakwad 只有十岁，却有一双大人般灵活修长的手和一头好莱坞印第安人的长发。
facts.anchor: Aanakwad was only ten that October, but he had grown-up hands—nimble and long like his grown-up hair.

facts.fact: Aanakwad 的哥哥 Tyrus 因殴打女友 Terri 被捕，而不是因为虐待弟弟。
facts.anchor: Not for the violet fingerprints I saw marking Aanakwad’s flesh—although I’d put those to his tally, too—but for roughing up his girlfriend, Terri.

facts.fact: 新年夜里 Aanakwad 受伤躺在救护担架上，把用红头巾包着、编好扎好的头发送给叙述者，说「不是偷来的」。
facts.anchor: His Hollywood hair all braided neatly and tied at both ends.

facts.fact: 抬上救护车前他问「多少印第安人能组成一个家」，她答「所有人」，他却说「只要两个」，然后拍拍胸口指向她。
facts.anchor: He shook his head and said softly, “Just two.”

facts.fact: 此后她成了一名活动家，教大家「新数学」——关于生存的统计、如何搅乱概率。
facts.anchor: So here I am teaching this new math.
